SELECTED_INDEX: 9
CONFIDENCE: 0.58
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a very strong benzene ring-breathing band at ~1004 cm⁻¹, aromatic C=C bands at 1593/1613 cm⁻¹, and both aromatic (~3057 cm⁻¹) and aliphatic (~2921 cm⁻¹) C–H stretches (GFQ-003). The distinct band at 1247 cm⁻¹ is characteristic of aryl–O stretching (phenolic/methoxy), and the 1380/1449 cm⁻¹ pair matches CH3 deformations, consistent with a methoxy group. Among candidates, only COc1cccc(O)c1O (9) has both aryl–O functionalities (phenolic OH and methoxy) and a methyl (OMe) to account for these features. The out-of-plane C–H bands at 721/746 cm⁻¹ support a non-para multi-substituted benzene. The 1613 cm⁻¹ band can also reflect H-bonded OH bending (GFQ-001). Overall, candidate 9 best fits the observed Raman pattern.
